builds.name: I Challenge My Fate!
builds.desc:
Lucina has great offensive stats, but what helps her stands out among her sword infantry peers is her Falchion. It can keep her healthy, she can slay dragons with it, and it can help give her an overall stat boost as well.
Weapon: Falchion is Lucina's weapon of choice. When given its special skill, it will grant Lucina +4 to all stats if she has an ally next to her. This increases her bulk when defending against attacks, while improving her already great offensive stat spread. The Falchion will also restore 10 HP every other turn, improving her sustain, which is especially helpful in endurance styled modes. Finally, it's effective against dragons, which means Lucina can help strike down any opposing dragons the player faces.
Assist: Reposition is a good Assist in general to use. Its uses are versatile, as it can either help bring an ally closer to the fray, or bring an ally out of danger.
Special: Glimmer is Lucina's Special of choice, as it has a fast charge and it helps her deal even more damage, which can help give her the upper hand in battle.
A Passive: Distant Counter is chosen as Lucina's A skill. With it, she'll be able to retaliate against ranged opponents, meaning they'll have to tread carefully around her, lest they face a vicious retaliation.
B Passive: Wrath 3 is Lucina's B skill. If she gets injured enough and activates her Special, it'll allow her to do even more damage. Afterwards, it'll help her charge it up again at a quickened pace.
C Passive: Spur Atk 3 is an option for Lucina's C skill, as she comes with it naturally and it can bolster the Atk of her allies. However, Lucina's C skill is flexible, open to be whatever the player needs. A buffing skill like a Drive or a Tactic skill could work well to help her support her team, but this is up to the player's team composition and discretion.
Sacred Seal: Quickened Pulse is required to bring Glimmer's charge down to 1. If an enemy engages her, Lucina will respond with Glimmer charged, potentially powered up by Wrath.

builds.name: Our Bonds Give me Strength!
builds.desc:
As Lucina is a Falchion wielder, she can serve as both an effective healer and a fighter, or she could opt to improve her great offensive capabilities further.
Weapon: Falchion is Lucina's weapon of choice. When given its special skill, it will grant Lucina +4 to all stats if she has an ally next to her. This increases her bulk when defending against attacks, while improving her already great offensive stat spread. The Falchion will also restore 10 HP every other turn, improving her sustain, which is especially helpful in endurance styled modes. It can also help offset the self injury from Fury 3. Finally, it's effective against dragons, which means Lucina can help strike down any opposing dragons the player faces.
Assist: Reciprocal Aid is what allows Lucina to act as a healer of sorts, and is best used if she has Renewal 3 as well. With these skills, Lucina will heal 20 HP every other turn, as well as 20 HP at the start of each map for endurance styled modes. She can then proceed to share her pool of HP with injured allies and have her skills heal back up the damages for herself. Should the player use Lucina in other modes or feel like this is not necessary, then another Assist like Reposition can be used instead for its movement utility, helping Lucina move her allies around instead.
Special: Glimmer is Lucina's Special of choice, as it has a fast charge and helps her do even more damage. With Lucina's high Spd, she'll be able to double a lot of her opponents and activate it, potentially helping her secure the victory against her foe.
A Passive: Fury 3 is chosen as Lucina's A skill. It improves her overall combat performance as it grants Lucina +3 to all stats, although this comes at the cost of 6 HP after each round of combat. However, the self injury is offset by the Falchion's self recovery.
B Passive: Renewal 3 is an option for Lucina's B skill if she wants to serve as a medic for her allies, and should only be chosen if her Assist is Reciprocal Aid. With it, she can heal even more HP, and it lines up with her Falchion's self recovery, letting Lucina heal 20 HP every other turn, which she can then use to help heal her allies. However, should the player feel like this is not necessary, or use Lucina in less drawn out game modes, then Swordbreaker 3 is a great option for her as her B skill. This instead lets her duel with opposing sword users and come out on top.
C Passive: Spur Atk 3 is an option for Lucina's C skill, as she comes with it naturally and it can bolster the Atk of her allies. However, Lucina's C skill is flexible, open to be whatever the player needs. A buffing skill like a Drive or a Tactic skill could work well to help her support her team, but this is up to the player's team composition and discretion.
Sacred Seal: Attack +3 is an option for Lucina's Seal slot, as a simple attack boost is always nice. However, this skill slot flexible, open to be whatever the player needs, depending on the player's team composition and discretion.

builds.name: Budget Sealed Lucina
builds.desc: Finally getting access to Sealed Falchion, the classic Fury + Desperation combo that Lucina had seen multiple times before can now be fully optimized. Reducing her own HP with Fury or Reciprocal Aid is perfect for boosting all of her stats by 5 thanks to her new weapon. With Fury 3 and her weapon, her Attack reaches an enormous 58, or 61 with an Attack boon, which is perfect for using the Heavy Blade seal with a variety of specials, not the least of which includes Aether, which comes with her base kit. The best part of this powerful build is how cheap it is, since there are no 5-star exclusive units that need to be sacrificed in order to make this. This new refinement option maximizes Lucina's offensive potential, and brings her right back near the top of the list of Infantry Sword users.

builds.name: Glass Cannon Lucina
builds.desc: This build utilizes Lucina’s exceptionally high speed by using her low Def and Res to get her into Brazen and Sealed Falchion range with a whopping 62 Atk and 51 Spd which is capable of doubling almost any opponent. Desperation allows Lucina to use her massive Atk and Spd to make a finishing blow without fearing a counterattack. Although she benefits from losing health, she can’t take much damage so her special heals her to where she can tank another hit under the right circumstances. A good choice for a seal is Deflect Melee allows Lucina to tank brave melee units so she doesn’t die instantly. However, a weakness to this build are Swordbreaker builds because despite having large speed, the enemy will make a follow up attack either way and will most likely kill her, and to top that off, she can’t make a follow up so it will be hard defeating the enemy with Swordbreaker.
